review.rationale:
Independent supervisory review of the exact Codex-authored configuration-obstruction candidate and permanent Codex regressions.

Declaration traversal now uses the existing settings._lookup with distinct _MISSING and _NON_TABLE sentinels. This removes the duplicate ambiguous _at traversal. Genuine missing keys remain absent; a non-table proper ancestor produces one declaration per affected selector with full semantic key, no ordinal or literal value, and the established non-table-parent unsupported reason. Existing resolution rejects those declarations without inventing alternatives, target values or facts. Supported siblings and explicit empty arrays retain their semantics. Dynamic readme and malformed TOML paths are unchanged. Namespace v3 deliberately invalidates old declaration/derived identities; no durable schema or public API is added.

The original independent oracle is unchanged (b79e12adfe12ad2f77b8a0e428a58a38c17c5ac4a8661e9e28b2aa53d0113f86) and passes 64 obstruction shapes. Permanent tests add 56 cases for every unique proper ancestor and each scalar family, provenance, determinism, valid siblings, absence, unsupported leaves, empty arrays, dynamic readme, malformed TOML and retained-source identity. One existing test asserted the precise tool=42 false-absence defect; its assertion is explicitly migrated to the required unsupported evidence rather than weakening the new contract. All 70 existing test scenarios remain.

No Qwen proposal was installed or semantically repaired. Existing replay adapters lack Engineering20 raw provider captures and do not authenticate reconstructed request/observation history on this advanced baseline, so the conditional continuation was skipped. Original task, oracle, early-stop result and native traces remain immutable. No model execution, tool-use success or behavioral repair is claimed. Worker prerequisites remain unchanged; the later-in-batch Tool failure safeguard remains required and is covered in the final protected profile.

Review is recommended only if the exact-source WorkCycle protected result passes with the production coverage threshold intact. Remaining limitations: only the existing six static selectors and named setting forms are modeled; no package/runtime configuration emulation or retrieval policy is claimed. Parent B-0002 and B-0009 remain open; protected-main destination review and authority are separate. The authorized effects are publication to the ordinary existing feature branch only.

regression_compatibility.resolution: Retain all 70 scenarios; correct that one obsolete assertion to README-only absence, five unsupported non-table-parent assessments and no facts. Add 56 new independent regression cases. No oracle, original task or historical result changed.
